# langsmith_org_usage (Data Source)

Returns billable-metric usage for the current LangSmith organization over a time window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_org_usage" "january" {
  starting_on   = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  ending_before = "2025-02-01T00:00:00Z"
}

output "usage_by_metric" {
  value = {
    for entry in data.langsmith_org_usage.january.usage :
    entry.billable_metric_name => entry.value...
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ending_before` (String) Exclusive end of the usage window (RFC 3339 timestamp).
- `starting_on` (String) Start of the usage window (RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. `2025-01-01T00:00:00Z`).

### Optional

- `on_current_plan` (Boolean) Whether to restrict usage to the organization's current plan. Defaults to `true` server-side.

### Read-Only

- `usage` (Attributes List) Usage entries, one per billable metric per period. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage))

<a id="nestedatt--usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage`

Read-Only:

- `billable_metric_id` (String) Identifier of the billable metric.
- `billable_metric_name` (String) Human-readable name of the billable metric.
- `customer_id` (String) Billing customer identifier.
- `end_timestamp` (String) End of the period this entry covers.
- `groups` (String) JSON-encoded map of per-group usage values; may be null.
- `start_timestamp` (String) Start of the period this entry covers.
- `value` (Number) Usage value for the metric; may be null.
